book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIHNINGNAH

content: Ma heh a uithungnah ka ca tlongnah he a cang a. Bia puimaw maikaw cawh hnikhuitu pahning a cang ly leh pathung aa ung long tah bia pacysah a cang.

Taico, a uihningnah ka ca tlong ning he takhei raering bia ka ca peh si thah he. Atoheh cawh a langpa tah ka ca ching vy hui he. Ka va kaw kaw tih leco, suanah tua katei, a ngepachih lypaw sahlo le ahringpaw sahlo khah dangtah lytah ca ung a bei he neh.
Ma cawh Khri tah kama hmang tah bia a reipaw a langsahnah hmuh naa du cawtah a cang. Khri cawh naaning khatah rai a hrening taco, a thaw dia be, a chongnah khah a langsah hri.

Bia dih a cangpaw cawh Khri cawh a ciacung ly ning tah khraws letah khaipai a cang, canghrasala Khazing hmingtuakhyná tah Ama cawh a hring. Ma hraco kaaning cawh Ama hratah a ciacung lypaw cang peh ka, canghrasala naaning naa cawtah rai hrepah rua pawtah Khazing hmingtuakhyná tah Ama leco kaa hringpaw a cang.

Zingnah letah na ung he ceh maw, ung ly he ceh tahpaw khah naaning teitah a pase la, a chaw teitah a mingpase tua my lo. Pasenah letah a tling lypaw naa cang tah cy ly co, naa chung letah Khri Zisu a ung tahpaw khah hnih thlang bei he ceh maw?
Taico, pasenah letah kaa tlingpaw khah naa hni thlang a, tatah ka zing.

Mataico, ahmang lypaw hming naa tua ly nápaw cawtah Khazing khatah thlaw kaa chang tei. Ma cawh pasenah letah ka daw khy peh takhah a lang sá pawtah cang lytah, a daw khy lypaw ky kaa lo thlang tahmai tah naaning cawh a dingpaw hming khah naa tua a paw a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah biahmuisui cawh ka dawkhui he peh tah ly co, biahmuisui cawh dy pawtah zehmai kaa tua khypaw ung be.
Kaaning heh kaa thaw a dia zong tah naaning naa thaw a tlung thlang caco, ka lawng thlang he peh. Taico kaa thlawchangnah cawh naaning mehtling naa cang nápaw cawtah a cang.

Ma cakua heh langpa tah ka va ciapaw cang ka, ma pawsui co naaning kha ka va tlung tihtah ka nawhnuinah cawh a sah pui tah hmang a hia a beh. Zemaw tah pawco ma nawhnuinah cawh naaning caphei nápawtah cang lytah naaning pacysah nápaw cawtah Abuipaw tah a pa pehpaw a cang.

A changnah letah uny sahlo a lawng my lo. Mehtling cang a pachia la, ka ca nawnah he khah nge my lo. Lungthing maekheh tah ung la, arai teitah ung my lo. Ma co donah le denah Khazing cawh naaning khatah a ung a.
Pakheh le pakheh khah lung pathai teitah bia a ching my lo.
Mehpathai vytei tah a dang pawtah aa ca tah he.
Abuipaw Zisu Khri ningdonah le Khazing donah le Thlawpaw Pathai huikongnah cawh naa zongmingtei cung letah ung ky seh.
